metadata.description: Stops current event playback and advances the queue. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Stops current event playback and advances the queue. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Stops current event playback and advances the queue. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Holds new playback while the current event finishes. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Holds new playback while the current event finishes. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Holds new playback while the current event finishes. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Continues held playback. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Continues held playback. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Continues held playback. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Removes pending events while current playback continues. Applies to all event origins across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Removes pending events while current playback continues. Applies to twitch events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.
Removes pending events while current playback continues. Applies to kick events only across this owner’s Global Overlay scenes.

Enables a command in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

Disables a command in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

Enables a redemption in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.

Disables a redemption in this channel. Quote names containing spaces. Optional 1-604800 seconds restores the previous state after the duration, including after restarts. Repeating the same timed change extends it; omitting duration cancels any pending restoration.
Adds an item; multiplier creates copies, weight sets chance per copy.
Removes an item and all its copies.
Updates an item multiplier and optionally its weight.
Shuffles individual copies without changing odds.
Selects the active roulette without changing visibility.
Shows the active roulette overlay.
Hides the roulette overlay without cancelling its draw.
Starts the active or specified roulette and saves one authoritative winner.
Returns the most recently completed winner label.

Returns the username of the caller / current chatter. Optional "ignore" filters strip characters from that name: "symbols" removes every character that is not a letter, combining mark or number, "numbers" removes numeric characters. Both filters can be combined in any order, and the name keeps its casing. Returns "viewer" when the filters leave no letters or numbers.
Returns the target username from the first argument; falls back to the caller when no argument is given.

Returns a random chatter, excluding the channel blacklist. Use unique to avoid earlier picks in this execution, ignore followed by logins for additional exclusions, or local to replace the shared blacklist with only those exclusions. Returns a placeholder if no eligible chatter remains.
Returns a random integer from 0 up to max-1. Max defaults to 100.
Issues an official Twitch warning to a user with a required reason (1-500 characters).
examples: warn someuser Please stop posting spoilers

metadata.description: Grants VIP to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Grants VIP to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Grants VIP to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Grants VIP to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Removes VIP from a user.
Bans or times out a user. Provide seconds for a timeout, omit it for a permanent ban.
AI chat only: bans or times out the verified chatter whose current message broke channel rules. Takes no username. Provide seconds for a timeout; omit for a permanent ban. Cannot affect anyone else.

Bans/times out a moderator: removes their mod status first, then applies the ban/timeout. With return_mod=true the mod status is restored after the timeout ends (requires a valid timeout). Seconds must be 1-604800. Level 8 applies to bot-driven (AST_PARSER) use; inside streamer-authored commands the command permission level controls who can trigger it.
Grants moderator to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Grants moderator to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Grants moderator to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Grants moderator to a user. Optional days makes it temporary (premium/pro plans only, 1-365 days).
Removes moderator from a user.

Grants a temporary bypass of the channel moderation filters (caps, links, emote spam, blacklist). With a username only that user is permitted; with only a number everyone is permitted for that many seconds; with no arguments everyone is permitted for 60 seconds.
Clears the entire chat history.
Toggles emote-only mode on/off. Optional seconds auto-disables it after the duration when enabling.
Returns true when the channel is live, false when offline or its status cannot be retrieved. Suitable for conditionals.
Returns the total subscriber count of the channel.
Returns the current stream title.
Returns the current game/category of the channel or optional target login.
Returns the current viewer count.
Returns the total follower count of the channel.
Returns the display name of the channel or optional target login.
Returns the login name (lowercase, URL-safe) of the channel or optional target login.
Persistent per-command counter: adds the increment and returns the total. With no inline increment, a signed chat argument such as -3 is supported; inline signed numbers are not.
Simple counter: increments the per-command count by 1 and returns the new value.
Returns the bits amount of the current cheer event context (0 outside cheer events).
Starts a raid to another channel.
Cancels an active raid.
Changes the stream title.
Changes the stream category. Searches Twitch categories by name and picks the best match.
Changes the channel default Fish TTS voice to one of the four built-in voices or a saved favorite. Also selects Fish as the TTS provider. A voice outside this account is rejected.

Starts a channel points prediction (betting with points). Options are separated by / and the three parts (title, options, seconds) by ;. Requires 2-10 options. The whole argument must be wrapped in double quotes because ; is reserved syntax.

Reads the current active or locked prediction from Twitch and returns its question and numbered option titles. Call this before end.prediction so the winner matches the question and actual option order.
Closes betting on the current prediction without choosing a winner. Already locked predictions are left unchanged.

Resolves the current active or locked prediction with the exact winning option title or its number (starting at 1). Call get.prediction first to inspect the question and actual option order. The current prediction is fetched again before resolving.
Cancels the current active or locked channel points prediction without choosing a winner. Fetches the current prediction from Twitch.

Starts a native Twitch poll with 2-5 slash-separated options. Separate title, options, seconds, and optional Channel Points cost by semicolons inside double quotes. Omit the cost or use 0 for one free vote per viewer; 1-1000000 enables paid extra votes.
Reads the active poll, or the latest poll when none is active, including its question, status, numbered choices and vote totals.
Ends the current active poll and archives its results. Fetches the current poll from Twitch.
Terminates the current active poll without archiving its results. Fetches the current poll from Twitch.
Returns the duration in seconds of the current ad break (event data).
Returns the duration in seconds of the current ad break (event data).
Generates an AI response for the given prompt using the channel AI personality.
Best effort: shows a cached selected clip from the target login (optional @) on the overlay. Missing or invalid targets, no clips or disconnected overlay produce no output.
Creates a clip of the current stream moment and returns the clip URL. Optional clip title.
Returns how long a user has been following the channel (years, months, days, hours). Defaults to the caller.
Timeout duration in seconds from a temporary ban event (banned_at and ends_at). Returns 0 for permanent bans or missing or invalid timestamps.
Number of months the viewer has been a moderator, from modiversary.months. Returns 0 when no valid moderator anniversary is present.
Watch streak count from the current chat notification (watch_streak.streak_count). Returns 0 when no valid watch streak is present.
Display name of the channel raiding us (raid event data).
Login name of the channel raiding us (raid event data).
Number of viewers brought by the incoming raid (raid event data).
Bits amount of the current cheer event.
Text message attached to the current cheer event.
Subscription tier of the current sub event (Prime, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3).
Cumulative subscription months of the current sub event.
Recipient username of a gifted subscription event.
Current hype train progress points.
Current hype train level.
End time of the current hype train.
Target channel of a shoutout event.
User input text from a channel point reward redemption.
User input text from a channel point reward redemption.
Reports the channel speech overlay connection, playing/preparing/idle state and waiting TTS count. Includes Global Overlay Studio. Read-only.
Returns a boolean: true when a speech overlay or TTS-enabled Studio source is connected. False when disconnected or lookup fails. Read-only.
Returns the number of waiting TTS messages, including retained Studio deliveries, excluding current speech. Duplicate OBS sources count once. Returns -1 if lookup fails. Read-only.
Stops the current TTS item and advances to the next waiting request.
Stops current TTS playback and removes all waiting TTS requests.
Resets connected speech playback and reconnects overlay sockets, discarding interrupted speech while preserving waiting TTS requests. An offline OBS source must be reopened manually.
Speaks text with a Kokoro preset voice using DeepInfra only. Costs one credit per 15 characters, rounded up; falls back to Piper when credits are exhausted or synthesis fails.
Speaks a message out loud using the channel default TTS voice.
Speaks a message using Piper (1 credit per 50 characters, rounded up), including after credit exhaustion.
Speaks a message using Piper (1 credit per 50 characters, rounded up), including after credit exhaustion.
Speaks a message out loud using the channel default TTS voice.
Speaks a message with a named Fish Audio cloned voice. First argument is the voice name or voice ID, the rest is the message.
Speaks a message with a named Fish Audio cloned voice. First argument is the voice name or voice ID, the rest is the message.
Speaks supplied text with the pet voice, without an LLM. Waits its turn in the TTS queue, in order with normal TTS messages. Requires a configured command or Twitch event action.
Asks the pet personality for a reply, then speaks it. Waits in the TTS queue or the pet queue, as set on the Pet page. Requires a configured command or Twitch event action.

Sends a named signal with an optional value to the channel's Overlay Studio custom widgets; the widget's code decides what it does (a pet eats, a wheel spins, colours change). Works in Twitch chat commands, keywords and event actions (not timers, channel-point rewards or AI requests). Widgets receive it when their widget.json uses "signals". Silent in chat. Names: letters, digits and _ (max 40); value up to 500 characters.

Like widget.signal, but only custom widget layers with this name react (quote names with spaces; published names count). Works in Twitch chat commands, keywords and event actions (not timers, channel-point rewards or AI requests). Widgets receive it when their widget.json uses "signals". Silent in chat.
Record an item on a configured currency goal. This does not charge a customer or verify a sale.
Fires a configured sound/video trigger by name. Optional true/false last argument controls queueing.

Schedules an unevaluated message and its nested actions after 1-604800 seconds. Returns immediately. Survives bot restarts in cache; overdue jobs run within a 10-minute grace period, then expire. Each invocation creates a separate timer; execution is at most once.
Pauses execution for the given number of seconds (0-60). Used to sequence multi-step command flows.
Exits the current loop immediately.
Skips the rest of the current loop iteration and continues with the next one.

Sends a Twitch announcement. Optional first word selects blue, green, orange, purple or primary; default primary. Message must be 1-500 characters. Returns the message for normal delivery if the announcement fails.

Sends a Twitch announcement. Optional first word selects blue, green, orange, purple or primary; default primary. Message must be 1-500 characters. Returns the message for normal delivery if the announcement fails.
Sends only a native Twitch shoutout to the target login (optional @). Missing or invalid targets do nothing.

Sends a Twitch announcement. Optional first word selects blue, green, orange, purple or primary; default primary. Message must be 1-500 characters. Returns the message for normal delivery if the announcement fails.
Sends a message to chat as the bot.
Follow-defense control: "attack" queues attack mode, "status" reports the current defense mode and time remaining.
Sends a message to chat and pins it. Optional duration in seconds (30-1800) as first argument.
Sends a message to chat and pins it. Optional duration in seconds (30-1800) as first argument.
Updates the duration of the currently pinned message (30-1800 seconds).
Unpins the currently pinned chat message.
Unpins the currently pinned chat message.
Converts text to UPPERCASE.
Converts text to lowercase.
Converts text to Title Case (first letter of each word capitalized).
Capitalizes only the first character of the text.
Removes leading and trailing whitespace from text.
Returns the character count of the text.
Extracts a substring by index. Negative indexes wrap from the end. Numeric args come first, then the text.
Literal replace-all of a search string with a replacement (no regex). Quote multi-word search/replacement.
